column1: # Original WritingDeck plot situations. MIT to the extent copyright subsists; AI-assisted original drafting, not copied modern prompts.
# stable_id|category|genres|premise

wd-p-0101|mobility|realist,political|A bus driver discovers that the last run of her route exists only because a former dispatcher never processed its cancellation. Reporting the error would strand the passengers who use it, while concealing it would prevent the route from receiving the repairs it now needs.

wd-p-0102|expertise|mystery,realist|A piano tuner recognizes a distinctive fault in an instrument donated to a school. The fault identifies it as a piano declared destroyed in a fire, but the music teacher who accepted it used the insurance settlement to establish the school's only music program.

wd-p-0103|friendship|realist,romance|Two friends promise to tell each other before accepting jobs that would separate them. One receives an offer to replace the other, who has secretly recommended her while preparing to leave a profession neither has admitted wanting to escape.

wd-p-0104|measurement|speculative,political|A city measures prosperity by how rarely residents ask for help. A statistician finds that a district's remarkable improvement follows the removal of every public way to request assistance, and the district is about to receive control of the city's welfare budget.

wd-p-0105|craft|realist,family|A potter is asked to repair a ceremonial vessel her estranged father made. She finds that its hidden join was repaired by her mother long before he claimed sole authorship, and preserving the vessel would cover the evidence again.

wd-p-0106|witness|mystery,realist|A delivery cyclist is the only witness to a collision, but her account places her on a street she was paid to avoid. The restriction was meant to conceal a client's residence, and explaining the route would disclose the client without improving the accuracy of what she saw.

wd-p-0107|reversal|speculative,adventure|A tunnel crew breaks through into a settlement that has spent generations trying to seal the same passage. The crew's survey says the tunnel is an emergency escape route, while the settlement's records describe it as the cause of the emergency.

wd-p-0108|ceremony|realist,family|A family asks a nonreligious relative to lead a memorial because she is good at public speaking. The deceased left instructions for a ritual she cannot honestly perform, and another relative offers to take over only if she denies knowing about those instructions.

wd-p-0109|uncertainty|speculative,mystery|A machine identifies the single question whose answer would most improve a person's life. A detective receives a question about an unrelated childhood promise and must decide whether following it is a distraction or the only way to understand her current investigation.

wd-p-0110|labor|realist,political|A factory worker designs a safer procedure that also slows production. Management offers to adopt it if she signs a statement that the old procedure was adequate, preventing the injured workers who helped her test the redesign from using it as evidence.

wd-p-0111|memory|realist,family|A family recording contains a lullaby everyone attributes to a beloved uncle. A cousin identifies it as the song their grandmother used when the uncle was away, and reconstructing who was present threatens the family story about who cared for whom.

wd-p-0112|mobility|speculative,adventure|A train arrives once a year to evacuate a town before its valley floods. Its conductor discovers that the timetable was calculated before a new settlement was built, and stopping there would leave the train unable to clear the pass before the water rises.

wd-p-0113|expertise|realist,satire|A professional mediator is hired to settle a dispute between two amateur historical societies. Both agree to accept her decision only after she certifies their incompatible accounts of her own hometown, where she has avoided taking sides all her life.

wd-p-0114|friendship|mystery,realist|A woman receives a request from an old friend to destroy a borrowed notebook. The friend is alive but unreachable, and the notebook's seemingly trivial shopping lists explain why several people remember being rescued by a person who was never there.

wd-p-0115|measurement|realist,political|A school evaluates teachers by the improvement in their pupils' test scores. A teacher discovers that the pupils most in need of help are being reassigned just before the measurement begins, and correcting her own class list would cost the school its emergency funding.

wd-p-0116|craft|speculative,realist|A tailor can alter how strangers remember a garment's wearer. A customer asks for clothes that will make her entirely forgettable, but the tailor recognizes the measurements as those of the only witness who could identify a missing apprentice.

wd-p-0117|witness|realist,family|At a citizenship interview, a man is asked to describe the day he met the person sponsoring him. Their truthful accounts disagree because one remembers an earlier meeting the other has deliberately concealed to protect a mutual friend.

wd-p-0118|reversal|mystery,political|A journalist investigates an unusually efficient public office and finds that its staff quietly refuses the most difficult cases. The director offers full access to the files if she agrees to publish the identities of the people whose requests were rejected.

wd-p-0119|ceremony|speculative,family|A town ceremonially buries every child's first lie in a public garden. A gardener finds that an adult has been adding new lies to the same plot for years, and removing them would uproot the tree under which the town settles its disputes.

wd-p-0120|uncertainty|realist,adventure|A field scientist loses the label identifying which of two soil samples contains a dangerous contaminant. Retesting is possible only by returning to a site now occupied by families whose evacuation depends on the result.

wd-p-0121|labor|realist,romance|Two partners work opposite shifts in the same hotel and communicate through maintenance notes. A promotion would finally align their hours, but would make one responsible for disciplining the coworkers who have been covering the other's unfinished tasks.

wd-p-0122|memory|speculative,political|A public archive lets residents correct inaccurate memories held about them. An archivist discovers that corrections requested by powerful people are erasing other residents' accurate memories of being refused help, and the archive treats both requests as equally valid personal data.

wd-p-0123|craft|realist,mystery|A cabinetmaker restores a desk containing a hidden drawer that opens only when the desk is empty. Its owner insists that nothing be removed, while an inventory suggests that one object on the desktop was placed there specifically to keep the drawer shut.

wd-p-0124|expertise|speculative,satire|A planet hires an off-world consultant to explain why its flawless predictions keep producing unhappy decisions. The consultant finds that the predictions are accurate, but every recommended action assumes that avoiding disappointment matters more than choosing a desired life.

wd-p-0125|friendship|realist,family|An adult discovers that the birthday letters from a childhood friend were continued by the friend's parent after the friend lost interest. The parent now asks her to stop replying, just as she has begun relying on the correspondence during her own family crisis.

wd-p-0126|measurement|mystery,realist|A census worker finds an apartment occupied by a different household on every visit. Each household has genuine documents, and all insist on being counted at an address whose official capacity determines whether the building will be condemned.

wd-p-0127|witness|speculative,political|A court can replay an event exactly as one witness perceived it. A judge discovers that replaying the most reliable witness repeatedly makes everyone in the court share the witness's unnoticed assumption about who had authority to act.

wd-p-0128|reversal|realist,adventure|A rescue worker reaches a remote cabin to evacuate its owner before a landslide. The owner is ready to leave but refuses to abandon a device maintaining the slope, and the worker's evacuation plan would disconnect its power.

wd-p-0129|ceremony|realist,romance|A wedding celebrant realizes that the vows supplied by one partner were written by the other partner's former spouse. The wording is freely offered and lovingly intended, but disclosing its origin would require admitting that the celebrant helped write it years earlier.

wd-p-0130|uncertainty|speculative,family|A child inherits a compass that points toward the person most in need of an apology from its holder. It keeps pointing toward a parent who insists nothing is wrong, while the sibling expecting an apology believes the compass must be broken.

wd-p-0131|labor|realist,political|A warehouse cooperative votes to automate its hardest task. The worker who has mastered it supports the change, then discovers that the training data will turn her years of undocumented adaptations into a product owned by the departing manager.

wd-p-0132|place|realist,family|A neighborhood relocates a beloved bench during roadworks and discovers that its usual occupant refuses to use the new site. The original location allowed him to see an estranged relative without approaching, and restoring it would make that private arrangement visible to everyone helping him.

wd-p-0133|interpretation|mystery,realist|A cataloger finds that the captions on a photographer's contact sheets describe events that occur in the next frame, not the current one. The final caption names someone who appears nowhere in the surviving photographs and has asked that the negatives be destroyed.

wd-p-0134|promise|realist,romance|A couple agrees that either may end an argument by asking for a walk. When one starts using the rule to avoid every serious decision, the other discovers that the proposed route always passes a place the first partner is afraid to enter alone.

wd-p-0135|resilience|speculative,political|A colony's buildings repair themselves by borrowing material from structures designated nonessential. A maintenance worker finds that the designation has followed outdated population records, slowly dismantling the homes of residents who returned after an evacuation.

wd-p-0136|credit|realist,satire|A novelist asks her former writing group to endorse an account of her solitary creative struggle. One member finds a group exercise that contains the central device of the book, while another insists that treating the resemblance as ownership would betray the group's purpose.

wd-p-0137|permission|realist,family|An adult asks to read the letters his late mother wrote to a close friend. The friend offers the letters only if he also reads her replies, which reveal that his mother repeatedly defended choices he has spent years blaming the friend for encouraging.

wd-p-0138|pattern|speculative,mystery|A detective notices that crimes are solved faster in streets absent from the official city map. Adding them would improve emergency access, but the cartographer warns that recognition will bring the surveillance from which the residents originally hid.

wd-p-0139|reciprocity|realist,political|A mutual-aid organizer publishes accounts to prove that donations were fairly spent. The accounts reveal that one beneficiary has also been the fund's anonymous largest donor, and the demand for transparency threatens the care arrangement that made both roles necessary.

wd-p-0140|distance|realist,adventure|A traveler follows a trail of repaired shoes left by a missing sibling. The trail ends at a village where the sibling has become indispensable to people who cannot leave, and asking for a private reunion would interrupt the work keeping the next evacuation possible.

wd-p-0141|continuity|speculative,family|A family uses a device to share one uninterrupted conversation across several generations. A descendant discovers that an ancestor has been editing the pauses to hide long periods of estrangement, and restoring them would change who appears to have answered whom.

wd-p-0142|place|realist,political|A city names a new park after a local benefactor, then receives a request from the person whose home was demolished to create it. She does not oppose the park; she wants the dedication to state how the land was obtained, which the benefactor's gift agreement forbids.

wd-p-0143|interpretation|speculative,romance|Two people fall in love through a system that matches unfinished sentences to likely continuations. When they meet, each discovers that the sentences they most admired were generated from the other's rejected drafts rather than messages deliberately sent.

wd-p-0144|promise|mystery,realist|A debt collector is given a ledger in which every borrower has already repaid the principal. The remaining debt consists of favors promised to the original lender, and one favor requires the collector to conceal why the lender forgave his own father's loan.

wd-p-0145|resilience|realist,family|A family praised for rebuilding after a fire is asked to become the subject of a fundraising campaign. The eldest child knows that their apparent recovery depends on borrowed furniture and unpaid labor from relatives excluded from the proposed portrait.

wd-p-0146|credit|speculative,political|A research station grants citizenship to whoever first proves a new discovery. A technician finds that the discoveries are being divided into smaller claims so that established residents can renew privileges while newcomers perform work that never qualifies as first proof.

wd-p-0147|permission|realist,romance|A woman agrees to lend her home for a friend's reconciliation dinner. When the guests arrive separately, she learns that each believes she will be present as an advocate, and hosting without taking sides would violate both private agreements.

wd-p-0148|pattern|mystery,family|A man finds identical corrections in all the recipes inherited by different branches of his family. The changes remove ingredients associated with a relative nobody mentions, but one branch has kept serving the uncorrected dish under a different name.

wd-p-0149|reciprocity|speculative,realist|A town borrows seasons from neighboring valleys to stabilize its harvests. The keeper of the accounts discovers that a poor valley has been repaying winter with longer winters, and a fair settlement would disrupt the climate on which the town's new orchard depends.

wd-p-0150|distance|realist,romance|Two long-distance partners keep a shared map of places they will visit together. One finds that the other has already visited several alone, not from indifference but to check whether the locations can accommodate a disability they have not yet discussed.

wd-p-0151|continuity|realist,political|A civil servant is instructed to preserve a historic queue when a service moves online. She discovers that the paper queue includes people who have died and excludes those who stopped attending daily, making any literal transfer repeat the barriers the move was meant to remove.

wd-p-0152|place|speculative,mystery|A surveyor finds a small room that appears in every abandoned house but in no inhabited one. A missing-person investigator wants to occupy it as a stakeout, although doing so would erase the only feature linking the disappearances.

wd-p-0153|interpretation|realist,satire|A town hires an artist to produce a mural based entirely on residents' suggestions. The suggestions form a coherent scene only if one omitted group is painted as the obstacle, and the committee refuses both the honest composition and the artist's request to reconsider its brief.

wd-p-0154|promise|realist,family|A parent promises a child that they will never move again, then is offered housing that would make the family's daily life safer. The child agrees to the move only if the parent explains why the earlier promise was made when it could not be guaranteed.

wd-p-0155|resilience|speculative,adventure|A rescue drone returns from a storm with improvised repairs made by someone outside its permitted search area. Its operator can locate the repairer only by admitting that the supposedly exhaustive search map excluded a whole inhabited ridge.

wd-p-0156|credit|mystery,realist|A scholar finds a notebook proving that a discredited researcher correctly predicted a celebrated discovery. The notebook also shows that the prediction depended on observations taken without permission from a community now asking the scholar not to publish them.

wd-p-0157|permission|realist,political|A neighborhood committee unanimously approves a festival, then learns that the resident responsible for the translation never translated the permit's noise conditions. Enforcing the conditions would exclude the musicians whose participation made several neighbors agree in the first place.

wd-p-0158|pattern|speculative,family|A family clock runs faster whenever someone avoids a necessary conversation. A repairer discovers that its apparent malfunction began when the youngest family member stopped being invited to the conversations everyone else considers necessary.

wd-p-0159|reciprocity|realist,romance|A couple makes a list of favors to settle before separating. An apparently minor borrowed bicycle becomes the last item because returning it would end the route by which both have been checking on an isolated neighbor.

wd-p-0160|distance|realist,political|A rural school loses funding because the official route planner shows a short journey to another school. A bus driver knows that the route crosses a bridge closed every winter, but recording the detour would also expose an unlicensed stop on which several families depend.

wd-p-0161|continuity|speculative,realist|A settlement preserves one unchanging room so returning travelers can recognize home after decades away. Its caretaker needs to replace a failing wall, and every proposed repair would erase a mark that a different traveler considers the room's essential feature.

wd-p-0162|judgment|realist,mystery|A professional reference checker finds that a job applicant's glowing recommendations were written by people the applicant dismissed. They are genuine accounts of kindness, but the applicant will not explain why each writer insists that hiring her is a public responsibility.

wd-p-0163|interdependence|speculative,political|An island can become invisible to storms by removing its name from every map. Its council discovers that another island has been using the same name, so protecting one settlement would redirect the weather toward people who never agreed to share the risk.

wd-p-0164|authenticity|realist,family|A family restaurant replaces a grandmother's handwritten menu with a polished translation. A grandchild discovers that several peculiar phrases were private jokes with regular customers, and correcting the language would remove the only surviving record of those relationships.

wd-p-0165|choice|realist,romance|Two partners each secretly decline a career opportunity to keep the other from having to move. When the employers merge, both refusals become visible, and the couple must decide whose imagined sacrifice has been directing their shared life.

wd-p-0166|authority|mystery,political|A temporary official signs emergency permits during a blackout, then learns that one saved the archive containing proof that she lacked authority to issue any of them. Validating the necessary work would require admitting the defect in her own appointment.

wd-p-0167|shelter|speculative,adventure|A storm shelter opens only to people carrying a recognized household token. A traveler finds a way to duplicate tokens, but every copy reassigns part of an existing household's reserved space, making rescue inseparable from consent.

wd-p-0168|exchange|realist,family|A woman sells a piano to cover her brother's debt, then learns that he has been earning money by promising its use to a neighborhood choir. Retrieving it would cost the choir its rehearsal room; leaving it sold would make his first honest repayment impossible.

wd-p-0169|trust|realist,political|A tenant organizer wins a promise that no one will be evicted during negotiations. A resident then asks to leave urgently, but the landlord treats a voluntary departure as proof that the promise does not cover the remaining residents.

wd-p-0170|loss|speculative,romance|A couple can preserve one day together exactly as it occurred, but viewing it replaces their memories of everything they later learned about that day. One wants to revisit a happy anniversary; the other now understands why it ended with an unexplained absence.

wd-p-0171|coordination|mystery,realist|A dispatcher notices that emergency calls from one block always arrive through a caller on another street. The caller has been bridging a service gap without permission, and an investigation would shut the workaround before a replacement can be installed.

wd-p-0172|judgment|speculative,family|A family asks an ancestral simulation to settle a disputed inheritance. It refuses to decide until each claimant explains why they need the property now, revealing how little the simulation's accurate family history says about their present lives.

wd-p-0173|interdependence|realist,adventure|A climber reaches a hut whose emergency supplies have been used exactly as instructed. The previous party replaced them with a cache farther uphill, leaving the climber to decide whether to risk the ascent or turn away the exhausted group approaching behind her.

wd-p-0174|authenticity|mystery,realist|A collector asks a craftswoman to certify an heirloom as her grandfather's work. She recognizes it as a piece he taught a prisoner to make, and the certification would determine whether the prisoner's surviving family can claim the object back.

wd-p-0175|choice|speculative,political|A city offers residents the right to reverse one official decision affecting them. A clerk learns that reversing a housing denial would undo the later allocation to another family, and the policy contains no way to hear both claims at once.

wd-p-0176|authority|realist,family|A man caring for his aunt discovers that the relative holding legal authority has been following her old written preferences rather than her changed wishes. His aunt asks him to challenge the arrangement without revealing the private reason her preferences changed.

wd-p-0177|shelter|realist,romance|Two former partners are assigned the same emergency accommodation after a flood because an old registry still lists them together. Correcting the record would place one far from the child they jointly care for, while keeping it would conceal another resident's valid need for the room.

wd-p-0178|exchange|speculative,satire|A city introduces a currency that expires when hoarded. Its treasury discovers that the richest resident keeps wealth circulating through invented transactions, and prosecuting the scheme would invalidate the wages paid to everyone maintaining the fictitious businesses.

wd-p-0179|trust|mystery,family|A woman finds that the weekly updates about her missing uncle were composed in advance. The person sending them genuinely does not know where he is, but the last unsent update describes a family event that has not yet happened.

wd-p-0180|loss|realist,political|A demolition worker discovers a wall used for generations to record children's heights. Preserving it would delay housing needed by the current residents, while photographing it would turn private family histories into a public exhibition without their agreement.

wd-p-0181|coordination|speculative,adventure|A fleet's ships can communicate only by changing the pattern of their navigation lights. A rescue ship must choose between sending a message that will reveal the fleet to pursuers and maintaining the pattern that guides a damaged vessel through the dark.

wd-p-0182|judgment|realist,satire|A committee appoints a chair because she has never benefited from its grants. She discovers that her unpaid work prepared most successful applications, making the committee's preferred proof of independence a record of contributions it never acknowledged.

wd-p-0183|interdependence|realist,family|A son encourages his retired father to stop repairing neighbors' appliances for free. When the service ends, he discovers that the neighbors had been quietly supplying the social contact and meals his father refused to request directly.

wd-p-0184|authenticity|speculative,mystery|An archive distinguishes original documents from perfect copies by recording the intentions of their makers. A legal claim depends on a copy made with more faithful intentions than the original, and the archivist's rules recognize authenticity but not truth.

wd-p-0185|choice|realist,romance|A couple agrees that a coin toss will settle which city to live in. The result relieves one and disappoints the other, and the person who proposed the rule must decide whether honoring it matters more than what their reactions have finally revealed.

wd-p-0186|authority|realist,political|A newly appointed inspector closes an unsafe market stall, then discovers that the entire market shares the same improvised electrical supply. Applying the rule uniformly would remove a neighborhood's food access before the city can provide a safe alternative.

wd-p-0187|shelter|speculative,family|A house makes room for anyone its residents sincerely call family. During a reunion it begins shrinking, and the owner must discover which guest's inclusion is being privately denied before the corridors connecting the rooms disappear.

wd-p-0188|exchange|mystery,realist|A woman receives payment for a service she has never offered, with instructions to pass half to a stranger. Refunding it reveals that the money came from a trust established to repay a debt nobody wants recorded as charity.

wd-p-0189|trust|realist,romance|A couple shares passwords as a gesture of openness, then one changes a password to protect a friend's confidential message. Explaining the change would betray the friend, while silence makes the other's reasonable request for reassurance look like an accusation.

wd-p-0190|loss|speculative,political|A city's flood defenses are powered by residents' surrendered memories of lost places. A planner discovers that the most generous donors are losing the knowledge needed to rebuild those same neighborhoods, making successful protection undermine recovery.

wd-p-0191|coordination|realist,adventure|A volunteer pilot receives two identical landing-clearance messages from different airstrips. One contains a copied instruction that would be safe only at the other, and the dispatcher who could clarify it has gone to repair the transmitter leaving both strips reachable.

wd-p-0192|judgment|mystery,realist|An appraiser values an ordinary toolbox at almost nothing, then finds that several families independently claim it as the means by which their homes were saved. The executor will return it only to one owner, requiring proof that measures something other than price.

wd-p-0193|interdependence|speculative,romance|Two people share a device that lets each borrow the other's alertness during difficult work. When one begins needing it for routine tasks, the other discovers that their agreement never distinguished emergency support from an unequal daily expectation.

wd-p-0194|authenticity|realist,political|A town reconstructs a demolished meeting hall using residents' memories. The most widely remembered layout excludes an entrance once used by people barred from the main door, and including it would contradict the donors' preferred account of the hall as an equal space.

wd-p-0195|choice|realist,family|Three siblings agree to sell inherited land, then learn that their parent gave a neighbor an unwritten lifetime right to cross it. The buyer will honor the right only if the siblings accept less money, and one sibling needs the full share to remain housed.

wd-p-0196|authority|speculative,mystery|A station's safety system recognizes emergency commands only in a long-dead administrator's voice. A linguist can reconstruct it from recordings, but the only complete recording is an order that the station's residents have spent generations denying was ever issued.

wd-p-0197|shelter|realist,family|A woman offers a spare room to a distant relative, then discovers that several relatives have promised the same room as the final step in separate plans for his care. Hosting him would make her responsible for agreements she was never asked to accept.

wd-p-0198|exchange|realist,political|A worker-owned café offers free meals in exchange for future volunteer hours. During an economic downturn, the unredeemed hours exceed all the work the café can provide, and canceling the balances would erase the contributions of people who still need meals.

wd-p-0199|trust|speculative,adventure|A crew follows a rescue beacon programmed never to lie about the location of survivors. At the destination they find a thriving settlement and learn that the beacon's definition of rescue includes people who do not wish to leave.

wd-p-0200|loss|realist,romance|A woman helps her former partner sort belongings after a move. They find an object neither wants but both have kept to avoid admitting that a shared plan is over, and deciding who takes it forces a conversation their practical cooperation has postponed.

wd-p-0201|coordination|mystery,political|A public accountant finds that several departments each budgeted for the same emergency shelter. The shelter is real but can serve only one district at a time, and revealing the duplication would make every department's disaster plan fail inspection simultaneously.
